drhp.business: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited manufactures and sells submersible pumps, motors, VFDs, inverters and their spare parts, with core products spanning solar pump sets, agricultural pumps and industrial pumps. Its portfolio extends to smart monitoring solutions, rooftop solar products and EV components (motors, controllers and chargers), delivered to agriculture, water management, industrial and clean-energy applications. The Company operates a backward-integrated manufacturing model and sells through Government Projects, Industrial, OEM, Retail and Export channels.

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR material-issues table as a risk: electricity constitutes a significant operating expense in the manufacture of water pumps, and escalating power tariffs, interruptions in grid availability and reliance on conventional energy sources may lead to higher production costs and disrupt manufacturing schedules. Mitigation is through energy-consumption tracking, energy-efficient technologies, renewable energy integration and peak demand management.
risks.risk: Energy cost and grid availability in manufacturing

risks.note: BRSR flags that pumps require certain metals and components that may have limited global suppliers and be subject to price volatility or geopolitical risk; disruptions can delay production and impact margins. Mitigated by supplier diversification, long-term supply agreements, alternative materials and strategic inventory reserves.
risks.risk: Raw material and component sourcing concentration

risks.note: Employees are exposed to occupational risks from heavy equipment, electrical systems and movement of large or cumbersome materials; shortcomings in safety practices may lead to injuries, production disruption, regulatory consequences and reputational damage. Managed through stringent SOPs, periodic training, mandatory PPE, preventive maintenance and hazard/incident reporting.
risks.risk: Workforce health and safety in heavy manufacturing

risks.note: Permanent-employee turnover rose to 26.03% in FY2025-26 from 10.24% in FY2024-25. The Company attributes this to early attrition among freshers who were unwilling to work in the assigned domain despite it being communicated at campus hiring, and to newly established regional renewable-segment companies offering higher compensation and benefits.
risks.risk: Talent attrition in a competitive renewable energy labour market

risks.note: The BRSR reports 100% of turnover from a single main activity - manufacture of electrical equipment and general/special purpose machinery - and 100% of turnover from the manufacture of pumps, leaving the business without a diversifying revenue line outside the pumping and allied equipment franchise.

Government institutions are described as a significant customer group, with the Company playing a vital role in flagship rural solarisation initiatives such as PM-KUSUM. Scheme design, tendering pace and policy change therefore drive a material share of demand.
risks.risk: Dependence on government schemes and institutional buyers

risks.note: Export sales represented approximately 13.75% of total turnover during the reporting period, spread across more than 100 countries and served through international agencies, project developers and institutional buyers, exposing the business to overseas demand, currency and geopolitical conditions.

Management explicitly cautions that actual results may differ materially due to changes in economic conditions, government policies, regulatory developments, industry dynamics, technological advancements, competitive intensity, geopolitical events and climate-related risks.
risks.risk: External macro, policy, technology and climate factors flagged in the forward-looking statement
